verdict.rationale: Unstructured offers deployment in your own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation. That implicitly lets a customer control where data resides, but only through an enterprise or custom-priced deployment, not a documented region picker. Its GDPR compliance claim describes data handling practices, not a residency choice. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection for the hosted SaaS, documentation of available regions or residency guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.
